stories.label: Still waiting · World · Press
stories.head: Dawit Isaak
bullets: Journalist arrested 23 Sep 2001; never charged or tried.
Held incommunicado; whereabouts and health unknown.
Eritrea's president has said there will be no trial and no release.
stories.caption: CPJ reports that no family or lawyer visits have been allowed.

stories.label: Still waiting · India · Due process
stories.head: Umar Khalid
bullets: Held under the UAPA since 13 Sep 2020; trial has not begun.
Delhi High Court rejected his bail for the third time on 30 Sep 2026.
Police called fresh bail pleas premature.
stories.src: Bar & Bench · Citizens for Justice and Peace
stories.caption: He is accused in the 2020 Delhi riots conspiracy case.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Detention
stories.head: Detainees of the RSF
bullets: Sudan Doctors Network reports 6,500+ held in El Geneina, with food shortages and deaths.
Amnesty reports torture, forced labour and release for ransom in El Fasher.
stories.caption: The RSF took El Fasher on 26 October 2025. Amnesty says fewer than 70,000 people remain in the city, which had more than a million before the war.

stories.label: Still waiting · World · Expression
stories.head: Najmeh Amini
bullets: Sentenced to death for blasphemy over social media posts, plus 12.5 years on security charges.
stories.src: Center for Human Rights in Iran
stories.caption: She is held in Mashhad Central Prison.
